correctness.rationale: For the exact normalized beta moments M_n=n!Γ(α+2)/Γ(n+α+2), angular orthogonality of (I-P_α)(conj(z)^m z^n) diagonalizes squared Hankel singular values as M_(n+m)/M_n - 1_(n≥m) M_n/M_(n-m). For fixed m≥3, expand the two m-factor rational products in α^-1 uniformly with t=n/α on compact subsets of (0,∞). Their cancellation yields αλ=F_m(t)+α^-1 G_m(t)+O_m(α^-2), with F=m²t^(m-1)/(1+t)^(m+1), G=m² t^(m-2)[2t²-2(m+1)t+m-1]/[2(1+t)^(m+2)]. The source telescoping upper bound excludes n/α→0 or infinity, and differentiable expansions plus the unique nondegenerate maximum t_m=(m-1)/2 yield all maximizers n=αt_m+O_m(1). At the maximum G_m(t_m)=-F_m(t_m)=-K_m, K_m=4m²(m-1)^(m-1)/(m+1)^(m+1); hence C²=K_m/(α+1)+O_m(α^-3). Independently verified exact beta moments and optimizer convergence for m=3..9 at multiple integer α; this does not prove arbitrary real α or all m.

originality.rationale: The exact best analytic approximation constant is the norm of the big Hankel operator with the specific symbol conj(z)^m, and this must be compared to Hankel singular values and not to unrelated Bergman interpolation constants. Bourass–El-Fallah–Marrhich–Naqos 2021 studies singular value asymptotics at fixed radial weight as index grows; their inspected primary theorem is not a high-weight, optimizer-index semiclassical law with the universal second-order cancellation. Rouby–Sjöstrand–Vũ Ngọc 2018 is a general analytic Bergman semiclassical framework, without an explicit order-m beta-profile maximization theorem. The plausible classical Arazy–Fisher–Peetre 1988 source could not be read after arXiv/OA attempts; authorized Oxford attempt returned vpn_disconnected, not scientific contradiction. Distinct asymptotic parameter quantifiers and all-m correction survive checked coverage best-of-knowledge, with material priority risk.
